title: Calendar calculations
description: Exact calendar arithmetic on Gregorian dates: the number of days between two dates (with a years/months/days breakdown and weekday count), the date N days before or after a date, and the weekday, ISO week and day of the year of a date. Use it instead of mental arithmetic whenever an answer depends on exact date math.
when_not_to_use: Time zones, clock times, historical calendars (Julian), holidays or business-day calendars of a specific country, and questions about what happened on a date.
examples: какая дата будет через 90 дней после 2026-10-14?
сколько лет, месяцев и дней прошло с 1998-07-20 по 2026-10-14?

operation.description: between: date → other_date; shift: date + days; describe: facts about date

output_description: between: days (signed), weeks, years/months/days breakdown, weekdays (Mon-Fri) count; shift: result date and weekday; describe: weekday, ISO week, day of year, leap year, days left in the year.
